notes.title: 《Mini War - Three Kingdoms》is on sale now！There is -20% discount for sale!
notes.notes:
After several months of development, the minimalist tactical game 《Mini War - Three Kingdoms》has finally been officially launched!

Making a game with originality and high gameplay has always been my dream. It means a lot to me, and it's a great thing to celebrate.

But now the sale is around the corner, my heart is a little apprehensive and uneasy. To be able to complete a game that you really want to make is something to be happy about, but now I am under a lot of pressure. On the one hand, I am worried that you will not like it, and the other is that  I afraid of betraying my original intention. So I have to try my best to make this game better and better, in order to win your faver.

Looking back on several months of R & D, I feel mixed feelings. I hope you can gain happiness from our work.
